rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Senate decided at 6h34 on Thursday 12 May, by 55 votes to 22, to open the impeachment process against President Dilma Rousseff. The First Secretary was to take the notification to the Palácio do Planalto that morning, and a notification telling Vice-President Michel Temer that he is the one governing in exercise; Dilma Rousseff steps away from the office for at most 180 days and Temer should assume the Presidency that Thursday.
